verses.text: A Psalm of the sons of Korah. A song. He has founded His city on the holy mountains.

segments.text: A Psalm of the sons of Korah. A song. He has founded His city on the holy mountains.

verses.text: The LORD loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.

segments.text: The LORD loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.

verses.text: Glorious things are ascribed to you, O city of God. Selah

segments.text: Glorious things are ascribed to you, O city of God. Selah

verses.text: “I will mention Rahab and Babylon among those who know Me—along with Philistia, Tyre, and Cush—when I say, ‘This one was born in Zion.’”

segments.text: “I will mention Rahab and Babylon among those who know Me—along with Philistia, Tyre, and Cush—when I say, ‘This one was born in Zion.’”

verses.text: And it will be said of Zion: “This one and that one were born in her, and the Most High Himself will establish her.”

segments.text: And it will be said of Zion: “This one and that one were born in her, and the Most High Himself will establish her.”

verses.text: The LORD will record in the register of the peoples: “This one was born in Zion.” Selah

segments.text: The LORD will record in the register of the peoples: “This one was born in Zion.” Selah

verses.text: Singers and pipers will proclaim, “All my springs of joy are in You.”

segments.text: Singers and pipers will proclaim, “All my springs of joy are in You.”
